newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Circuit to buy MicroClock.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Circuit to buy MicroClock.

text.p: Integrated Circuit Systems Inc said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire MicroClock Inc for $15.6 million in cash and stock.

The company said it expected the acquisition, which would be accounted for as a purchase, will result in a one-time charge to earnings of about $11 million in the third quarter related to the writeoff of research and development costs.
It said it will buy the entire capital stock of MicroClock with about 660,000 in shares plus $5.6 million in cash.
MicroClock, which makes clock synthesizer integrated circuits, will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Integrated Circuits.
Integrated Circuit makes integrated circuit products that focus on frequency timing, multimedia and data communications applications.
